findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_project · Private data: check_handle, list_apps, new_project, list_files, read_file, write_files, change_status · Public sink: new_project, write_files, change_status, check_project · Destructive: write_files.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_project · Private data: check_handle, list_apps, new_project, list_files, read_file, write_files, change_status · Public sink: new_project, write_files, change_status, check_project · Destructive: write_files

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
